NEW, found while gating batch 2: the scenes harness's dex sprite measurement is non-deterministic by ~2px. Proved it by reverting EVERY batch-2 file in a copy and re-recording -- HEAD's own code does not reproduce HEAD's own recorded baseline (x/y/w/h 124,161,127,127 vs 125,163,125,125). Within tolerance so it never fails, but UPDATE_BASELINE=1 re-records it every time, which puts unrelated churn in any diff that touches baselines and makes a real drift harder to spot. Likely the mocked 1x1 sprite settling. Worth pinning.

B-047 CONFIRMED AND WORSE THAN FILED: sw.js caches on `resp.ok || resp.type === 'opaque'`, and an opaque response is status 0 whether it was a picture, a 404 or a rate-limit. ASSET_CACHE is version-independent ('pokedexos-assets') and activate() only deletes keys ending in '-shell', so a bad sprite is cached PERMANENTLY -- a release bump will not clear it and nothing prunes it. The only cure is clearing site data, which is also where both boys' saves live. B-018 second bug CONFIRMED: the delegated image net (main.js:417-423) early-returns on img.dataset.fellBack==='1', and #poke-sprite is ONE long-lived reused all session, so the SECOND sprite failure of a session is never caught and the broken-image glyph stays for the rest of it. B-009's own notes say the forum's diagnosis is wrong (#card-close is position:sticky, in flow) -- the real defect is its box-shadow masking a 10px strip mid-scroll; confirmed visually in the card screenshot taken during batch 2. B-016 and B-017 read as filed.
